notes.g_point_estimate: The manuscript baseline point estimate is 0.053021. The trajectory-bootstrap distribution has mean 0.053031; these are intentionally not treated as the same quantity.
notes.jump_provenance: Recorded quantum-jump event times are used to separate no-jump increments from jump-containing increments.
notes.hazard_model: The relaxation hazard uses the physics-informed form lambda_i(X)=gamma*P_ei; gamma is estimated from event exposure.
